in_sanskrit.name: विस्नु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The preserver of the universe, the god of preservation, protection, and sustainability. The name is derived from the Sanskrit root 'vis' meaning 'to be' and 'snu' meaning 'to be present'. Thus, Bisnu can be interpreted as 'He who is present and sustains the universe'.

in_hindi.name: विस्नु
in_hindi.long_meaning: The creator and sustainer of the universe, the supreme god in Hinduism. The name is derived from the Sanskrit root 'vis' meaning 'to be' and 'snu' meaning 'to be present'. Thus, Bisnu can be interpreted as 'He who is present and sustains the universe' in Hindi as well.

in_tamil.name: விழு
in_tamil.long_meaning: The preserver and protector, the god of sustainability and prosperity. The name is derived from the Tamil root 'vi' meaning 'to be' and 'zhu' meaning 'to hold'. Thus, Bisnu can be interpreted as 'He who holds and sustains' in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: విశ్ణు
in_telugu.long_meaning: The preserver and sustainer of the universe, the god of preservation and protection. The name is derived from the Telugu root 'vi' meaning 'to be' and 'shnu' meaning 'to be present'. Thus, Bisnu can be interpreted as 'He who is present and sustains' in Telugu.
